title: Graceful shutdown with signal handling and connection draining
description: Adds built‑in support for graceful shutdown on SIGINT/SIGTERM, allowing ongoing requests to finish and resources to be cleaned up before the process exits. This prevents dropped connections and data loss in production deployments.
testCases: Simulate SIGTERM during active requests and verify that the server stops accepting new connections but completes in‑flight requests before exiting
Trigger SIGINT when no requests are pending and ensure the process exits with status 0 after cleanup callbacks run
acceptance: When the process receives SIGINT or SIGTERM, the server stops accepting new connections, waits up to a configurable timeout for active requests to complete, runs registered cleanup hooks, and then exits with code 0. If the timeout expires, the process force‑exits with code 1. All tests pass and no unhandled promise rejections occur.
reason: Production services need reliable termination to avoid client errors and resource leaks; implementing graceful shutdown directly in yantraverse eliminates the need for external wrappers and improves operational stability.
